test_cases.prompt: ground-my-take: does note A on spaced repetition connect to note B on compound interest?
test_cases.expected_output: Runs a /grounding session, orienting the take with Compass (West/Connect and East/Challenge as needed, North/South as plain questions) and running Distil once West and East both produce something, applies the purity check before writing (rejects a draft sentence that merely restates one cited note unchanged), writes an evergreen note citing both notes with stated reasons, and runs the five-item sign-off before finishing.

test_cases.prompt: ground-my-take, just a bare hunch with nothing named yet
test_cases.expected_output: Searches for related existing notes before starting; if nothing relevant turns up, treats the ungrounded hunch as a valid, complete session per grounding's own handling of 'neither present.'

test_cases.prompt: ground-my-take, revisiting an evergreen note written three months ago
test_cases.expected_output: Reads the existing note fresh from disk, and the resulting rewrite can replace its existing content wholesale rather than only appending — unlike a Reference note's append-only rule.
